_about: Reference for skill 'add-task'. NOT loaded by the engine. Use as the source of truth when generating new task files.

shape.answer: string[] — array of choice ids (single element unless multi=true)

shape.match: { caseSensitive: false, trim: true, collapseWhitespace: true }

shape.pairs: [{left: string, right: string}], min 2, unique lefts and rights

shape.words: [{word: string (Cyrillic letters, no spaces), stress: integer — 0-based letter index of the stressed vowel}], min 2, unique words
shape.defaultCount: integer 1..len(words). Pre-selected value on the setup screen; defaults to len(words) if omitted

shape.items: [{context?:string, word:string, correct:string, wrong:string, note?:string, countRange?:[number,number]}], min 2, unique by (context, word). If countRange is given, the renderer picks a random integer in [min, max] at session start and substitutes {N} with the Russian cardinal in context/correct/wrong (and the same number is used everywhere within one item).
shape.defaultCount: integer 1..len(items). Pre-selected value on the setup screen; defaults to len(items) if omitted
